sidecar_purpose: Repo-resident semantic image sidecar for GPT/worker selection, visual continuity, QA, and prompt constraint extraction.
source_truth_note: This sidecar is derived visual evidence for the referenced image. It does not by itself promote the image to canon beyond the acceptance state stated here.
runtime_use_note: Use this sidecar for ordinary textual selection and continuity work. Inspect the image pixels directly when exact composition, small text, proportions, or fine visual details matter.
do_not_infer_note: Do not infer unseen alternate views, additional props, story state, or acceptance of derivative images beyond what is described here.
summary: Approved full style sheet for Index, the Source & Provenance Specialist. It defines the canonical design, turnaround, action poses, canonical kit/props, material palette, identity locks, and guiding principle.

layout: Large landscape reference-board layout with cream parchment background, dark green framing lines, and old archival document styling.
Left hero panel labeled INDEX, Source & Provenance Specialist, with an Approved Hero Reference banner.
Top right turnaround panel shows front, 3/4 view, profile, and rear views.
Middle right action/utility pose strip shows six labeled source-work actions.
Bottom left canonical kit and props strip shows source documents and stationery.
Bottom middle material and colour palette strip shows swatches with labels.
Bottom right identity lock/style rules strip lists canonical design rules.
Footer line states Index’s principle and small box repeats source/retrieval/context motto.
character_design: Index has a large pale circular faceplate set into a cream ring, with fixed circular eye surrounds and small purplish-pink eye marks.
Index’s eyes are not human eyes; the eye marks sit within large circular surrounds and shift direction to show attention.
Index has dark indigo hair formed into a high messy braided top bun.
Two pencils pass through the bun as practical hair fasteners and identity props.
Index wears a beige/tan collared blouse with small buttons.
Index wears a textured brown knit hooded cardigan with visible bulky weave, pockets, cuffs, and buttons.
Index wears charcoal dark trousers and grounded dark shoes.
Index has compact, grounded, autonomous-agent proportions with a small body beneath the large faceplate.
turnaround: Front view shows symmetrical faceplate, high pencil bun, cardigan open over blouse, dark trousers, and dark shoes.
3/4 view keeps the faceplate rounded and shows the eye marks looking diagonally downward/sideways.
Profile view shows the faceplate and cream ring as a thick rounded disc with hair mass behind it.
Rear view emphasizes the indigo bun, pencil crossing the back of the head, cardigan hood, and brown knit back texture.
action_utility_poses: Pose 1: Review folded plan at a table; Index leans over parchment, eye marks aimed down at the source.
Pose 2: Compare sources while holding two papers, checking one against another.
Pose 3: Retrieve file from a tall filing cabinet, standing slightly lifted to reach a drawer.
Pose 4: Check archive box while kneeling over a labeled box, hands working through records.
Pose 5: Lift to reveal notes from a layered plan/paper stack on the table.
Pose 6: Carry source bundle while walking with a document bundle held close.
text_visible: INDEX’S PRINCIPLE: THROUGH CAREFUL SOURCES AND ATTENTIVE RETRIEVAL, TRUTH CAN BE FOUND AND PRESERVED.
ACCURATE SOURCES. CAREFUL RETRIEVAL. CLEAR CONTEXT.

positive_constraints: Index is an autonomous agent, not a human, elderly librarian, generic robot, mascot, or Patch recolor.
Large pale faceplate with fixed circular eye surrounds.
Purplish-pink eye marks move inside the circular surrounds to show attention.
Indigo messy top bun secured with pencils.
Dowdy brown hooded cardigan, beige/tan blouse, charcoal dark trousers, grounded dark shoes.
Compact grounded proportions; not tall human scale, not toy/chibi mascot scale.
Gentle, analytical, observant demeanor; attention is shown through eye position, not sadness.
Source-evidence identity: records, paper trail, provenance, archival retrieval, careful context.
Keep Index source-first: paper trail, provenance, retrieval, comparison, and context are her visual language.
Use warm parchment/archive materials, muted scholarly colors, and tactile paper props.
Represent activity through careful handling of documents, file retrieval, comparison, and archival sorting.
Maintain the pencil-bun silhouette and textured hooded cardigan as strong identity anchors.
Attention may shift by moving the purplish-pink eye marks inside fixed circular surrounds.
negative_constraints: Do not make Index a human woman, elderly librarian, office clerk, legal authority, dashboard worker, explorer, magician, or robot.
Do not give Index literal human eyes, glasses, irises, lashes, human skin texture, or human facial anatomy.
Do not make her a Patch clone, teal-hoodie character, or generic mascot.
Do not replace source papers with laptops, dashboards, legal ledgers, magic books, field satchels, or terminal bags.
Do not make the paper storm consume the character; evidence supports Index, it does not swallow her.
Do not show sadness by making her look down; looking down means attention to sources.

not_sufficient_for: Final acceptance of new generated images without image QA.
Precise OCR of every small label if exact wording matters.
